description: Find the invoice in the data folder, refuse a draft, mark it paid, save it, return it

decisions.question: What does it do, step by step (read, check, change, save, call) - e.g. read the invoice, check it is a draft, send it, mark it sent?
decisions.answer: Read the invoice; refuse a draft (ValueError); set status paid; save; return it

decisions.question: Something it needs does not exist: which domain error - e.g. InvoiceNotFound?
Run twice with the same input (a retry, a re-run) - e.g. "send invoice F-42" twice: same result and no duplicate effect, or a domain error?
decisions.answer: The same result: an invoice already paid stays paid, saved again unchanged
decisions.suggested: The same result, no duplicate effect

decisions.question: What must be all or nothing, and what happens if a step fails in the middle - e.g. the e-mail is sent but marking it sent fails?
decisions.answer: Only one change, one save: nothing to undo

questions.title: Personal data
questions.question: Purpose: why does it process personal data (the fields of its spec card), and for whom - e.g. to send invoices to customers, for the finance team?
questions.answer: To record which customers paid their invoices, for the finance team

questions.title: Personal data
questions.question: Legal basis (GDPR art. 6): consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task or legitimate interests - and where is it recorded - e.g. contract, in the record of processing?

safety.question: Something missing (an input, a file, a setting, a dependency down): what must never happen?
Done twice (run twice, retried, the same input twice): what must never happen?

hazards.description: Paying twice changes the invoice twice

prevented_by.statement: marking an invoice paid twice gives the same invoice as once

safety.question: Half done (a file half written, a change saved here and not there, a crash in the middle): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: One save, written completely or not at all (invoices_repository.INV1)

safety.question: Two runs at the same time (two processes, two users): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: Two runs write the same paid invoice (decision 3)

safety.question: Data exposed (secrets or personal data in a log, an output, an error message): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: Nothing is logged or printed here
